items.title: Milt Hinton interviewed by Joe Williams, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995
items.q: Willis Conover. The clarinet player, what was his name? He was an assistant, he used to play the clarinet in Woody Herman’s band.

ctx.x: I thought Willis had something to do with that.
